title: HDFC Bank submits two candidates to RBI for next CEO
text: HDFC Bank submits two candidates to RBI for next CEO. India's ​largest ​private lender HDFC Bank has ‌submitted ⁠the ⁠names ​of two candidates ​to the ​Reserve Bank ⁠of India ‌for ​the ​position ⁠of managing director ​and chief executive ​officer, Bloomberg News ‌reported on ​Saturday, ​citing an ⁠exchange filing.
